question: Will the U.S. unemployment rate (BLS, seasonally adjusted) for October 2024 (the latest monthly reading dated on or before 2024-10-13) be above 4.1%, its value for June 2024?

rule.threshold_basis: the latest reading as of 2024-07-15 (June 2024), rounded as shown

source: Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
